content.title: Delayed and Cancelled Flights Are Piling Up
content.summary: Flight cancellations are piling up ahead of the looming winter storm.  As of Friday afternoon, more than 560 flights in or out of U.S. airports were canceled, according to flight-data provider FlightAware.  For Saturday, more than 2,300 flights have been preemptively cancelled, and almost 1,600 for Sunday.

content.title: Flights Cancellations Mount Ahead of Winter Storm
content.summary: As of Friday morning, more than 450 flights in or out of U.S. airports were canceled, according to flight-data provider FlightAware.  American Airlines has already canceled more than 500 of its own flights on Saturday, accounting for nearly a fifth of its scheduled itineraries that day.  Regional carriers Envoy Air and PSA Airlines, which operate American-branded flights, have canceled nearly 400 flights as well.
